content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

Platforms like Gumroad or Payhip offer hosted stores with payment processing. You upload products, set prices, and share links. They handle everything—for a cost. Sovereign stacks use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for crypto processing, and Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automation. You own the infrastructure. No platform fees. No platform rules. Gumroad charges 10% per sale. NOWPayments charges 0.5%. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921. Platforms rent convenience. Sovereign stacks sell ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms block entire countries due to payment processor restrictions. If Stripe or PayPal doesn’t support your region, neither does Gumroad. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with no KYC. Buyers in restricted regions can pay with USDT, BTC, or SOL. The stack doesn’t care about borders. It verifies on-chain payment and delivers the product. No platform intermediary to enforce geographic lockout. Your store operates where others cannot.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Platforms settle payments weekly or monthly. Sovereign stacks settle the moment payment confirms on-chain. NOWPayments fires a webhook instantly. Fees are transparent. 0.5% per transaction. No monthly subscriptions. No hidden costs. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. Compare this to Gumroad’s 10% plus payment processor fees. At scale, the difference is not marginal. It’s existential. You keep more revenue. Customers pay less in network fees.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. Gumroad charges 10%. At scale, the difference is existential.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms own your store. They can suspend it. They can change their terms. Sovereign stacks are yours after deployment. COREMERCH has no access. No platform dependency. Automation is built into the stack. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle order processing and file delivery. Products are stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The system is self-contained. No third-party APIs to break. No platform to revoke access. You own the code. You own the data. You own the infrastructure.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choose platforms if you sell one product once. Choose sovereign stacks if you sell many products repeatedly. Platforms are convenient for one-offs. Sovereign stacks are infrastructure for businesses. If you’re in a restricted region, sovereign stacks are not optional. They’re mandatory. If you value ownership over convenience, deploy a stack. If you want to keep 99.5% of your revenue, deploy a stack. The tradeoff is clear. Rent convenience or own infrastructure. The choice is architectural.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for crypto processing, and Google Apps Script for automation. This architecture bypasses platform restrictions entirely. Buyers pay with USDT, BTC, or SOL. The stack verifies on-chain payment and delivers the ebook instantly. No platform fees. No geographic lockout. Full ownership of the infrastructure.
Sovereign stacks settle payments the moment they confirm on-chain. Platforms settle weekly or monthly.

If you’re selling notion templates for USDT or digital downloads with crypto, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all 6 blueprints and 7 templates to deploy a sovereign stack. It includes NOWPayments integration guides and scaling playbooks. Everything you need to build, deploy, and scale. Instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Worth $348 separately.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
